item.title: Simultaneous Bulk Doping and Surface reconstruction Engineering by SeS 2 Treatment Enable Stable High‐Voltage Performance of LiCoO 2 at 4.6 V
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 SeS₂ treatment simultaneously bulk-dopes LiCoO₂ with Se and reconstructs its surface, forming a Li₂SO₃/Li₂SO₄/Li₂SeO₄ heterojunction coating. This stabilizes lattice oxygen, suppresses phase transitions and interfacial reactions, and builds an inorganic-rich CEI layer. The synergy enables 80.6% capacity retention at 4.6 V after 400 cycles versus 37.8% for pristine, offering a general bulk–surface strategy for high-voltage cathodes.
🏷 LiCoO2 · high-voltage cathode · surface reconstruction · SeS2 treatment · bulk doping
